policy.authority: This file is the sole machine-readable authority for the tc-cuda v1 subset. The compiler accept-list and all documentation are generated from it; doc and code cannot drift because they are one artefact.
policy.fail_closed: Any construct not listed here with status=supported is a build error that names the construct in CUDA's own vocabulary with file:line. There is no best-effort mode and no silent fallback.
policy.uniqueness: Every id is unique across supported and unsupported. Duplicate ids, unknown categories, or a status other than supported|unsupported are validation failures.

supported.name: __global__
supported.semantics: Kernel entry point: __global__ void f(...). Enumerated in the closed kernel manifest; link fails if any is not lowered (R1).

supported.name: __device__
supported.semantics: Device helper function, including inline and static linkage.

supported.name: template<int D>
supported.semantics: Non-type integral template parameter; explicit instantiation only. Type-parametric templates are out of scope.

supported.name: __restrict__
supported.semantics: Restriction qualifier on pointer parameters; must lower to a real noalias, not be dropped.

supported.name: threadIdx/blockIdx/blockDim/gridDim
supported.semantics: Launch geometry indexing with .x .y .z components; .y is used by training.cu and kimi_moe_cuda.cu.

supported.name: <<<grid, block>>>
supported.semantics: Kernel launch configuration with grid and block dimensions.

supported.name: <<<grid, block, dynamic_smem_bytes>>>
supported.semantics: Launch with dynamic shared-memory byte count; paired with C2.

supported.name: __shared__
supported.semantics: Static-extent shared-memory array.

supported.name: extern __shared__
supported.semantics: Dynamic shared-memory array; sized via the third launch argument (B3).

supported.name: __device__ variable + cudaMemcpyToSymbol/FromSymbol
supported.semantics: Module-scope device variable with symbol copy in both directions.

supported.name: global pointer load/store
supported.semantics: Global memory load/store, including const T* __restrict__.

supported.name: __syncthreads()
supported.semantics: Block-level barrier synchronisation.

supported.name: __shfl_sync
supported.semantics: Warp shuffle with explicit member mask.

supported.name: __shfl_xor_sync
supported.semantics: Warp shuffle-xor; highest-risk warp collective, see design §7.

supported.name: __shfl_down_sync
supported.semantics: Warp shuffle-down with explicit member mask.

supported.name: atomicAdd(float*, float)
supported.semantics: Global-memory float atomic add. Shared-memory and integer atomics are out of scope.

supported.name: __half
supported.semantics: Half-precision scalar, host and device storage; host/device attribute parity is part of the contract (R8).

supported.name: __half2
supported.semantics: Packed half-precision pair.

supported.name: __half2float / __float2half
supported.semantics: Half/float conversion, both __host__ __device__.

supported.name: __float2half_rn
supported.semantics: Round-to-nearest float to half.

supported.name: __float2half2_rn
supported.semantics: Round-to-nearest float to packed half2.

supported.name: __hfma2
supported.semantics: Packed half fused multiply-add.

supported.name: __hmul2
supported.semantics: Packed half multiply.

supported.name: __ushort_as_half
supported.semantics: Bit-cast between unsigned short and half; must not round-trip through float.

supported.name: sqrtf
supported.semantics: fp32 square root; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: rsqrtf
supported.semantics: fp32 reciprocal square root; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: expf
supported.semantics: fp32 natural exponential; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: logf
supported.semantics: fp32 natural logarithm; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: tanhf
supported.semantics: fp32 hyperbolic tangent; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: powf
supported.semantics: fp32 power; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: sinf
supported.semantics: fp32 sine; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: cosf
supported.semantics: fp32 cosine; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: fmaxf
supported.semantics: fp32 maximum; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: fminf
supported.semantics: fp32 minimum; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: fabsf
supported.semantics: fp32 absolute value; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: floorf
supported.semantics: fp32 floor; needs its own numerical golden.

supported.name: fmaf
supported.semantics: fp32 fused multiply-add; contraction policy is declared per translation unit (R4).

supported.name: __expf
supported.semantics: Fast exponential; maps to metal::fast::exp, not metal::exp.

supported.name: __logf
supported.semantics: Fast logarithm.

supported.name: __fmul_rn
supported.semantics: Round-to-nearest multiply; contraction barrier — must not be fused (R4).

supported.name: __fadd_rn
supported.semantics: Round-to-nearest add; contraction barrier — must not be fused (R4).

supported.name: integer/bit arithmetic
supported.semantics: uint8_t / unsigned short / int / long / size_t arithmetic, shifts, masks, casts; the whole of dequant_q4_t_kernel.

supported.name: integer division and modulo
supported.semantics: Integer division and modulo by a runtime value, e.g. idx / nblocks, idx % nblocks.

supported.name: cudaMalloc
supported.semantics: Device memory allocation.

supported.name: cudaMallocHost
supported.semantics: Pinned host memory allocation.

supported.name: cudaMallocManaged
supported.semantics: Unified managed memory; nearly free on Apple unified memory.

supported.name: cudaFree
supported.semantics: Device memory deallocation.

supported.name: cudaMemcpy / cudaMemcpyAsync
supported.semantics: Host/device memory copy in all 4 directions, sync and async.

supported.name: cudaMemset
supported.semantics: Device memory fill.

supported.name: cudaMemcpyToSymbol / cudaMemcpyFromSymbol
supported.semantics: Symbol-based device variable copy, both directions.

supported.name: cudaStream*
supported.semantics: Stream Create/WithFlags/Destroy/Synchronize.

supported.name: cudaEvent*
supported.semantics: Event Create/Record/Synchronize/ElapsedTime/Destroy.

supported.name: cudaDeviceSynchronize
supported.semantics: Device-wide synchronisation; keeps returning tcCudaErrorKernelNotLowered if a kernel was not lowered (R3).

supported.name: error surface
supported.semantics: cudaGetLastError, cudaGetErrorName, cudaSuccess, cudaError_t; no path from no-kernel to success (R3).

supported.name: device query
supported.semantics: cudaGetDevice/SetDevice/GetDeviceCount/GetDeviceProperties/cudaPointerGetAttributes/cudaFuncSetAttribute.

unsupported.name: wmma / mma_sync / tensor-core intrinsics
unsupported.reason: No backend mapping in v1; build error naming the construct.

unsupported.name: inline PTX (asm volatile)
unsupported.reason: Source-only route; PTX is not ingested (non-goal).

unsupported.name: cp.async
unsupported.reason: Async copy intrinsic has no v1 mapping.

unsupported.name: ldmatrix
unsupported.reason: Matrix load intrinsic has no v1 mapping.

unsupported.name: cooperative groups
unsupported.reason: No v1 lowering.

unsupported.name: CUDA graphs
unsupported.reason: No v1 lowering.

unsupported.name: dynamic parallelism
unsupported.reason: No v1 lowering.

unsupported.name: texture and surface objects
unsupported.reason: No v1 lowering.

unsupported.name: __constant__
unsupported.reason: Constant memory space not in v1.

unsupported.name: warp-vote (__ballot_sync, __any_sync, __all_sync)
unsupported.reason: No v1 mapping; silent_noop.cu asserts rejection.

unsupported.name: __syncwarp
unsupported.reason: Warp-level barrier not in v1.

unsupported.name: __ldg
unsupported.reason: Performance hint; rejecting avoids a silent performance cliff (R1).

unsupported.name: shared-memory atomics
unsupported.reason: Only global float atomicAdd (E1) is in scope.

unsupported.name: integer atomics
unsupported.reason: Only global float atomicAdd (E1) is in scope.

unsupported.name: atomicCAS / atomicExch / atomicMax
unsupported.reason: Only global float atomicAdd (E1) is in scope.

unsupported.name: double-precision math
unsupported.reason: No v1 fp64 device path.

unsupported.name: device-side printf
unsupported.reason: No v1 device I/O.

unsupported.name: device-side malloc/free/assert
unsupported.reason: No v1 device heap or assert.

unsupported.name: recursion
unsupported.reason: Device recursion not lowered in v1.

unsupported.name: virtual functions and RTTI in device code
unsupported.reason: No v1 device vtable/RTTI.

unsupported.name: type-parametric templates
unsupported.reason: Only non-type integral templates (A3) are in scope.

unsupported.name: __launch_bounds__
unsupported.reason: Performance hint; rejecting avoids a silent performance cliff (R1).

unsupported.name: multi-GPU peer access
unsupported.reason: No v1 peer mapping.

unsupported.name: stream callbacks
unsupported.reason: No v1 callback host hook.

unsupported.name: float4 / double2 vector types
unsupported.reason: Vector types not in v1.
